key.name: db-path
key.description: Absolute path to the last used database

key.name: db-list
key.description: List of known databases as (display_name, absolute_path) tuples

key.name: show-next-otp
key.description: If enabled, when the current OTP expires, the next one is shown too

key.name: notification-enabled
key.description: If enabled, a notification will pop-up everytime an OTP is copied

key.name: search-column
key.description: Select whether searching will be done on the Account or Issuer column

key.name: window-width
key.description: Default window width

key.name: window-height
key.description: Default window height

key.name: dark-theme
key.description: Whether the application should use a dark theme.

key.name: auto-lock
key.description: Whether to auto lock the application or not

key.name: auto-lock-timeout
key.description: Lock the application on idle after the specified amount of seconds

key.name: secret-service
key.description: Whether to store the database password in the system keyring so the app unlocks automatically after login

key.name: secret-service-v4-migrated
key.description: Tracks whether the v4 to v5 secret-service migration has run on this profile. Set after the first attempt, regardless of outcome. Do not modify.

key.name: search-provider-enabled
key.description: Whether the D-Bus search provider (GNOME Shell / KDE KRunner) is enabled

key.name: search-provider-keyword
key.description: The first token of a desktop search query must equal this keyword for OTPClient to return any results (e.g. "otp github"). An empty string disables the search provider entirely: every query is refused. Changes take effect immediately and invalidate previous activation IDs. The keyword is a query filter, not authentication.

key.name: show-validity-seconds
key.description: Show the remaining seconds of validity for each TOTP token

key.name: validity-color
key.description: Color used for the token validity countdown

key.name: validity-warning-color
key.description: Color used for the token validity countdown when time is running low

key.name: show-sidebar
key.description: Whether the database sidebar is visible

key.name: clipboard-clear-timeout
key.description: Seconds after which OTPClient clears its own copied OTP. Copying something else cancels the timer. Set to 0 to disable.

key.name: minimize-to-tray
key.description: Minimize window to system tray instead of closing

key.name: start-minimized
key.description: Start with the window hidden in the system tray instead of shown. Requires Minimize to Tray. If no tray accepts the icon, the window is shown normally.

key.name: autostart
key.description: Launch OTPClient automatically when you log in.

key.name: startup-reconcile-pending
key.summary: Startup settings still have to be stated to the desktop
key.description: Set when something writes minimize-to-tray, start-minimized or autostart without being able to act on them, which is what a command-line settings import does: it can change what the keys say, but not the login-time entry or the background permission they stand for. The next graphical launch states them to the desktop and clears this. Not part of the exported settings, since it describes this installation rather than a preference.

key.name: last-seen-version
key.description: Tracks the last version the user has seen, used to show What's New dialogs on upgrade

key.name: database-backup-times
key.summary: Last encrypted database backup by database path
key.description: Records successful explicit database copies. Migration exports do not count. Missing history means no backup is recorded for this database.

key.name: database-backup-snoozes
key.summary: Backup reminder snooze deadlines by database path
key.description: Unix timestamps until which the backup reminder is suppressed, per database path. Set when the user explicitly snoozes the reminder.

key.name: hide-otps
key.description: When enabled, the OTP value cell stays empty until Copy or Generate is activated. Selecting a row does not reveal or copy a code. A TOTP reveal lasts until the validity window rotates (then either auto-rolls to the next code when "show next OTP" is on, or hides). HOTP reveals are timed. Disabling this shows TOTP codes continuously; HOTP codes are shown only after successful generation.
